_about: ELFER RS (911 GT3 RS, 992): its steering wheel was cut out by material, leaving its chrome buttons and switches in the body: those pieces within its rim and 4.5 cm of its plane are moved onto it (wheel_parts: disc), so they turn with it. The central rev counter's face is blank grey in the model (its scale isn't modelled) but its needle is (a thin part of a material shared with other trim: max_size): it turns with the revs about the dial's hub. The two screens either side are one texture (Image_20, 1024 x 256: its UVs a tile over, uv_wrap; stored upside down, flip_v; painted squashed, the dials ellipses): the left screen's oil temperature gauge (blank) and speedometer (0 to 350, no needle; a car picture and Aerodynamics in its middle, a blank digital speed under it), the right screen's drive-mode dial and the fuel / water-temperature gauge (no needles, km with no number). Made live: the speedometer's needle along its painted scale (sy: the ellipse's height over its width), the speed in its digital slot, the oil temperature, the water temperature and fuel needles, the range. Pixels of the picture as it's seen; hub: m from the steering wheel's centre (x right, y up, z back).
